Gross pay before taxes and deductions, assuming 52 identical working weeks.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your annual salary.
  2. Enter how many hours you work per week.
  3. Enter how many days you work per week.
  4. Read your equivalent hourly, daily, weekly, biweekly and monthly pay.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the conversion calculated?

It divides your annual salary by 52 to get the weekly rate, then derives the rest from your hours-per-week and days-per-week. It assumes every week is identical.

Is this gross or net pay?

Gross pay before income tax, social security and any deductions. Actual take-home pay will be lower.

Does it account for overtime or bonuses?

No — it does not model overtime, bonuses, unpaid leave or variable schedules. It is a simple rate conversion.
